sec11.prompt: Jarvis Provider aur Riverpod me difference kya hai?
sec11.response: Boss, Jarvis Provider aur Riverpod dono state management libraries hain lekin unka approach alag hai. Jarvis Provider ek simple, direct way ke through state ko manage karta hai, jisme state ko ek provider se access kiya jata hai. Riverpod ek modern, flexible aur test-friendly approach hai jo Provider ki problem ko solve karta hai. Riverpod me state ko provider se access karte waqt ek function ke through kiya jata hai, jo ek stream ya future return karta hai. Isse testing aur performance me improvement aati hai.
